name: render_pipeline_from_scratch
description: F-4: the first 'build it from zero' story, done with Studio. File > New Project... makes a Blank pipeline project, whose present draws a gradient to display with the engine's engine://passthrough (VI-2). New render target... declares scene_color with only a name. The Pass Editor's own New pass (on this graph root the Frame Plan's Add fullscreen pass is the Graph's, GL-5c) puts draw_pattern before present, writing scene_color, with a fragment shader New... writes and the author's editor turns into stripes; saving the pass compiles it. Then present reads scene_color: F-6 lets the canvas edit a pass the blank project's direct root declares, so scene_color dragged onto present's band writes the root; engine://passthrough shows its input 0, so no shader is written for present. The viewport then shows stripes -- a few colours, the same colour down a stripe, another across it -- and opening the project once more gives the same canvas and the same picture, because it is all in the document.
